definitions.explanation: Characterized by intensity, force, or lack of gentleness.
Lacking politeness or gentleness in behavior or speech.
Describing excessive use of money, food, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{泳|およ}がないで→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't swim on days when the waves are rough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気性|きしょう}→気性：10450_kishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い。
⟦{金遣|かねづか}い→金遣い：10449_kanezukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荒|あら}い。

notes:
{荒|あら}い is an i-adjective describing roughness, wildness, or intensity.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {荒|あら}く
- Noun form: {荒|あら}さ (roughness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {波|なみ}が{荒|あら}い (rough waves)
- {気性|きしょう}が{荒|あら}い (violent temper)
- {金遣|かねづか}いが{荒|あら}い (spendthrift)
- {息|いき}が{荒|あら}い (breathing heavily)
- {言葉|ことば}が{荒|あら}い (harsh words)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {荒|あら}い vs. {粗|あら}い: Both read あらい, but {荒|あら}い refers to intensity/behavior (rough, wild), while {粗|あら}い refers to texture/quality (coarse, crude).

Register: Neutral. Can describe natural phenomena, personality, or behavior.
